gloss: photo developing lab; film processing facility

definitions.gloss: photo developing lab; film processing facility
definitions.explanation: A facility where photographic film is chemically processed to produce negatives and prints. While declining due to digital photography, some still exist for professional and film enthusiast use.

examples.japanese: ⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現像所|げんぞうじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To send film to the developing lab.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{現像所|げんぞうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{一軒|いっけん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There isn't a single photo lab left in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦デジタルカメラ→デジタルカメラ：28544_dejitarukamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{現像所|げんぞうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: With the spread of digital cameras, many photo developing labs have closed down.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{現像|げんぞう}→現像：06362_genzou⟧ (photo developing; film processing) + {所|じょ} (place; facility). The suffix {所|じょ} is used for various facilities: ⟦{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}→研究所：19075_kenkyuujo⟧ (research institute), ⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧ (office), ⟦{発電所|はつでんしょ}→発電所：15991_hatsudensho⟧ (power plant).

Once ubiquitous in Japanese neighborhoods, {現像所|げんぞうじょ} have become rare since the digital photography revolution. The remaining ones cater to professional photographers and film photography enthusiasts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現像所|げんぞうじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send to the developing lab
- {現像所|げんぞうじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧: to have finished at the lab
- ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{現像所|げんぞうじょ}: a specialized developing lab

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {写真屋|しゃしんや}: photo shop — a retail shop that takes photos and handles developing, more casual term
- ⟦{現像|げんぞう}→現像：06362_genzou⟧: developing; processing — the process itself
- DPE⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: DPE shop — Development, Printing, Enlargement shop; a once-common term for neighborhood photo shops
